objective: Independently audit coalescent Collatz rewrites, their least-permanent-safe-source implication, finite irreducible address pressure, transfer closure, companion thresholds, ratio decrement, and moving-shadow denominator bounds without promoting finite confluence or pressure to H72.

quantifiers: all binary words in the symbolic coalescent identity
all first-upcrossing renewal addresses of every block count with total odd count Q at most 13
all collision pairs and positive canonical rewrites in that complete address universe
all first-upcrossing words through Q=14 for the finite threshold regression
2144 mandatory adversarial convention instances plus Phase 7 macro id 0 and explicit NG21-NG23 boundaries
exact_scope.completeness: The rewrite graph, its minimum under the recorded order, and its normal forms are exhaustive only for total Q<=13. P81-P85 use separate exact proofs. General confluence, asymptotic irreducible pressure, P80, and H72 remain unproved.

arithmetic.floating_point_role: Decimal pressure fields are reporting-only; integers, Fraction, modular inverses, literal parity traces, and exact power inequalities decide acceptance.

verifier_reconstructs: the Q=4 and Q=13 affine identities, source cylinders, literal words, endpoints, and trace hashes
every first-upcrossing block and every Q<=13 address using a separate tuple representation
all endpoint classes, collision pairs, positive reductions, finite normal forms, and pressure fractions
the initial-run threshold minima and equality words through Q=14
all mandatory adversarial residues, Phase 7 macro id 0, and NG24's left-congruence counterexample

stop_conditions: Stop and preserve the least collision if either implementation disagrees on a word, correction, residue, literal endpoint, or normal form.
Do not infer global confluence or asymptotic pressure from Q<=13.
Do not use a quotient that fails NG24's left-composition regression.
Keep P80 conditional and H72 open unless ordinary-positive anti-concentration itself is proved.
Enter the proof-claim emergency protocol before any change to proves_collatz.
interpretation_boundary: An affine collision is not automatically a positive downward rewrite or a legal renewal address.
The least-source reduction applies to a least permanent-safe discrepancy-escaping counterexample source, conditionally supplied to the nonperiodic branch by EXT07/P74.
Finite unique normal forms do not imply Church-Rosser or an all-depth transfer operator.
The moving-shadow bounds are accepted for a_n>=1 and eventually under P76, not unconditionally at a_n=0.
